title: Strong convergence rates of tamed exponential Euler schemes for superlinear hyperbolic SPDEs
summary: In this paper, we prove pathwise uniform convergence at rates up to $1/2$ for tamed exponential Euler schemes for semilinear hyperbolic stochastic evolution equations with superlinearly growing nonlinearities and multiplicative noise. We take the term hyperbolic to mean that the leading operator generates a contractive $C_0$-semigroup but no parabolic smoothing occurs.
